notes: Account background: mid-market analytics SaaS serving B2B product teams. Heavy doc ingestion (user guides, transcripts, onboarding) + embeddings for search and recommendations.

Use-case detail: nightly batch vectorization job (~4M docs) + real-time embeddings for chat/search. Expect heavy write throughput during off-hours and moderate qps during day (target 100-200 embed/sec peak, 5-10k search qps across tenants via vector DB).
Latency targets: P95 search < 150ms (including vector DB hop). Embedding latency target < 250ms per request for realtime calls; batch throughput must finish within 6 hours overnight window.

Model preferences: prefer open / quantized models for cost control (Llama2-13B/ Mistral variants) but flexible to Redwood-verified variants. Want option to route to smaller/cheaper model on non-critical traffic.

Vector DB integration: currently piloting Pinecone (v1), evaluating hosted connector vs. self-managed Chroma. Key asks: native connector + batch bulk upsert API, efficient reindexing and delta updates (idempotent upserts), and clear cost breakdown for egress + storage.

POC scope agreed: (1) Validate embedding quality parity on 3 sample tasks (semantic search, rerank, similarity) using customer prompt set; (2) Run 1-night full batch ingest through Redwood hosted pipeline -> Pinecone to measure throughput/cost; (3) Demo Dedicated sizing and failover to hosted API.
Pricing sensitivity: mid-market procurement — pushing for committed monthly reserved capacity discount (target ~30% off list) vs pay-as-you-go. Ask for example TCO model for 100k-200k active users.

Security asks from infra team: VPC peering diagram, KMS integration for customer keys, retention controls for embeddings, audit logs (per-request) for 90 days. Quote: 'we need to show security for customers in finance vertical'
